# Morning briefing

**Yesterday** you closed the Hyprland layout question — dwindle on the ultrawide, master retired — and landed the Postgres migration fix after the CONCURRENTLY lesson. The backup pool got its NVMe special vdev, so the nightly rsync now finishes in 22 minutes instead of four hours.

**Open threads**

- The plugin API freeze you agreed with Sam still has no written cutoff date.
- Anna's OT moved to Thursdays at 4pm, so the standing infra window has to move to Friday.
- pgbouncer is in session mode as a workaround; the prepared-statement question is still open.

**Today**

Demo mode is the contest gate. It has to work on a machine with nothing installed, so prove that path end to end before polishing the briefing tab — the recall panel ships first by your own decision on Tuesday.

One caution from your own corrections: twice this week you assumed "it must be the index" and were wrong both times. Measure first.
